text:
I had my wisdom tooth surgery with Dr. Top, and I’m very happy with the experience. My wisdom tooth was deep and close to the nerve, so I was quite nervous about the possibility of numbness. Dr. Top carefully reviewed my X-ray, explained the risks clearly, and discussed the option of a CBCT without pressuring me.

The surgery itself was essentially painless. I only started feeling significant pain about 2 hours after the operation when the anesthesia wore off. After taking the prescribed medication, the pain was completely gone, and I had no bleeding. The next day, I honestly felt like nothing had happened—there was still some cheek swelling, but no pain at all.

What I appreciated most was how Dr. Top explained every step during the surgery, so I always knew what was happening. He was very careful around the nerve and was able to remove the entire tooth successfully.

The clinic is clean, modern, and well-equipped, and the staff were friendly and accommodating. The pricing is also very affordable and transparent, with clear post-op instructions and a medication guide provided.

The online customer service is top-notch as well, and I’m very satisfied with the overall service. I’ve been to many dental clinics before, but this clinic is honestly on another level in all aspects.

This is actually my first time ever leaving a review, because I’m genuinely very happy with the service I received. I’m now 14 days post-op and recovering very well.

If you’re an expat looking for a good dental clinic in Bangkok, don’t hesitate—book an appointment already! Highly recommended.
